artboards.title: Order entry on a phone — Omkar

annotations.text:
FOUR DESKS, FOUR SCREENS.
Today one role — front_office, "registration / OPD desk" — covers all of this, and counter-desk.tsx is one screen that finds, opens and bills. That is why nothing fits a real counter: the app's unit of work is a module, the counter's is one person from hello to goodbye.

Each screen below is scoped to what that seat is allowed to do. Enquiry can read everything and write only two things.

The appointment screen is the interactive one — type is fixed, but click a department or a doctor and the right-hand ladder re-computes.

Toggle Walk-in → Returned with results and watch Muskan move from 13th to 4th, behind Raju Singh. That ordering already exists server-side (opd.queueClass 0–4); no counter screen has ever shown it.

NEW WORK THIS DESIGN IMPLIES
· a symptom → department master ("cough" → General Medicine primary, Community Medicine secondary) — does not exist
· an enquiry role with read-everywhere / write-nothing
· bed availability readable from the enquiry desk
· registration allowed to book without changing route

Two interactive artboards here.

VITALS — click "Change" under the greyed height. Nothing unlocks until a reason is picked; the old value is kept beside the new one.

QUEUE — drag a row, or use the arrows, then press Call next. The board panel on the right mirrors what the hall sees: token and room, never a name.

This is a phone, in a corridor, held one-handed. Every target is at least 44 px and the whole page is shown unrolled so you can read it in one go.

The photograph is the load-bearing part: it is what lets Radiology catch the test Omkar missed.

Your field list, in the reference's three-column grammar, with CRK's own crest and palette — nothing of Medanta's identity is reproduced.

TWO THINGS I CHANGED AND WHY:
· Dates read 17-Apr-1998, not 170498. Six-digit dates are read wrong at counters, and the code already says so in token-slip.tsx.
· "Doctor ID (no name)" is honoured in the header — but the prescriber's name and NMC registration number appear at the signature block, because an Indian prescription is required to carry them.

opd_config.letterhead currently holds { name, addressLines } and the seeded name is still "Hospital (name pending — roadmap item #5)".

To print any of this it needs: logo, hotline, emergency, email, website, CIN/registration, QR password, NABL number, and the printed-by/page-count line.

The switch is not a preference — it moves where the token is issued, so it changes which role holds that permission.

Flow 2 needs a department-reception seat that Flow 1 does not have, and it needs the two refusals on the right-hand screen: an invoice from yesterday, and a patient who paid but never came upstairs.
